title: East Nashville Garden Apartment with 3 Bedrooms
description:
This Lockeland Springs garden apartment offers 3 spacious bedrooms and 4 comfy beds—perfect for couples, friends, or families. You’ll be just a few blocks from some of East Nashville’s favorites like Urban Cowboy and Lockeland Table, plus newer nearby hits including The Den, Bill’s Sandwich Palace, and Mama Bread.

It’s an easy walk to Five Points, and downtown is about 8 minutes by car. Comes with kitchenette (not a full kitchen), patio, charcoal grill, fire pit, and private entrance.

The space
The apartment is located on the lower floor of our house. You’ll have the entire floor to yourselves, as well as the backyard and lower patio.

Guest access
The apartment is located on the lower floor of our house. You’ll have the entire floor to yourselves, as well as the backyard, fire pit, grill, and lower patio. A lockbox code for access to keys will be provided to guests prior to checkin.

Other things to note
For guest comfort, we provide extra blankets, space heaters, pillows. We really want everyone to be comfortable so if you need anything, don't hesitate to ask. 

We've done our best to provide everything you need to cook a meal, but please note our kitchenette setup is limited. You'll have a mini fridge, tea and coffee station with Nespresso machine, kettle, and french press, induction hot plate, toaster oven, and microwave.
